name: Sónar Barcelona
description: Advanced music and electronic arts festival
place: Sónar by Night: Fira Gran Via; Sónar by Day: central Barcelona, venue TBA
price: SonarPass 160 EUR, SonarPass+D 175 EUR, VIP 275 EUR (fees incl.)
details: Day and night electronic music and arts festival with about 120,000 visitors. The "Sónar is dead" teaser (27 Oct 2026) ended with the 2027 announcement on 3 Nov: Sónar by Day returns to central Barcelona (17-19 June, venue not named yet; press expects Port Vell waterfront) and Sónar by Night stays at Fira Gran Via (18-19 June). First artists: Carl Cox, Bonobo, Peggy Gou, Jessie Ware, Romy (DJ set), Yung Lean, Cornelius, Goldie (live), Honey Dijon, Tokischa. SonarPass 160 EUR; Flex option refundable until 28 Feb 2027.
note: Carl Cox, Bonobo, Peggy Gou, Jessie Ware
